items.text: Thanks to Chuck & Casey at Williams Brothers Pharmacy in Bloomington for a discussion on ways to support home healthcare. We know when we meet healthcare needs at home, patients are more comfortable & it reduces costs for long-term care. I appreciate your insights! https://t.co/djip8qrX6Q

The treatment of detained American citizens in Turks & Caicos has been horrible over the recent months, and the response from the Department of State has been unacceptable. Steps must be taken to ensure that this never happens again. https://t.co/ET5FjFNnZS

Visited the Indiana Health Center in Bedford today. It was great to tour the newly renovated clinic and receive an update on the essential services offered to the community. Health centers like this are vital in ensuring access to quality care. A big thank you to the dedicated staff! #NationalHealthCenterWeek

Visited Harrison County Hospital and EMS yesterday, touring their impressive facility and meeting with the staff. Their hard work and commitment to their community’s health and safety are truly commendable. Thank you for having me! https://t.co/Lf6DDp2lGG

Big Tech and social media companies must be held accountable for putting American children at risk of online predators, cyberbullying, harmful content, data exploitation, and mental health issues.  Sen. @MarshaBlackburn and I sat down to discuss the importance of the Kids Online Safety Act on the latest episode of The Contender. 

🎙️Listen in on Spotify, YouTube or X.
The federal government should never fund or promote the chemical castration or medical mutilation of children. These procedures have harmed too many lives! https://t.co/5SZIccdetn

Hospitals exist to save lives, not impose medical mandates on vulnerable patients. @RepMichaelRulli and I introduced the COVID-19 Vaccination Non-Discrimination Act today to ensure no American is refused a transplant over personal medical decisions. 

https://t.co/qA64KnLE76

Yesterday, @RepMichaelRulli and I sent a letter to President Trump asking him to issue an Executive Order to block hospitals from denying organ transplants for people not vaccinated against COVID-19.

Patients – especially children – should never be turned away from care due to government-imposed mandates.

It was an honor to speak at the ERIC Policy Summit and share how we’re working in Congress to protect employer-sponsored insurance, expand access to care, and lower health care costs for working families. Grateful for the opportunity to join so many leaders focused on solutions that put patients first.

Latest bills introduced will:
✅ Prohibit federal funds for universities that hire illegal immigrants
✅ Protect U.S. educational institutions from foreign financial influence
✅ Improve access to care for patients with terminal illnesses
✅ Provide a federal tax credit to families with foster children

We’re standing up for students, families, and American values!

Today, the House voted to advance President Trump’s America First agenda to secure the border, cut taxes, slash government waste, and more all while protecting critical programs like Medicare and Social Security. This Budget Resolution is a roadmap to deliver on the promises we made to the American people to get our country back on track.

Had a great visit to IUS for a Science of Reading discussion. We talked about their strong partnerships with Ivy Tech, Hanover College, and the University of Indianapolis, as well as their impressive medical lab science program. They’re working hard to build pipelines and create pathways that meet community needs—and are already implementing changes aligned with the Indiana Literacy Framework.

Grateful to meet with the Family Resource Centers on Capitol Hill today. As a former Family Case Manager and a mom of three, I know the impact Family Resource Centers have. They offer real help—job training, mental health support, parenting tools—to keep families strong and kids out of crisis.

We’re on hour 20 of the @HouseCommerce Committee markup, and Democrats continue to mislead and fearmonger. @HouseGOP wants to STRENGTHEN and PROTECT Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security for those who truly need it— pregnant women, children, individuals with disabilities, and seniors. 

These Americans will continue to have access to the care they deserve!

While Democrats continue to mislead the American people, @HouseGOP is setting the record straight on our One Big, Beautiful Bill.

We are NOT cutting Medicaid, Medicare, or Social Security for those who truly need it. We ARE cutting waste, fraud, and abuse! https://t.co/6UztUlJl4k

Federal benefits were meant for our most vulnerable Americans—pregnant women, children, seniors, and individuals with disabilities. The One Big Beautiful Bill protects coverage for them and ends taxpayer-funded benefits for illegal immigrants, duplicate enrollees, and able-bodied adults who refuse to work.

Recently, I had the opportunity to visit Margaret Mary Health to tour their Oncology Center and get a firsthand look at their new hospital currently under construction. A key focus of the visit was their impressive investment in geothermal energy—an innovative, long-term solution to help power the future of healthcare in the region.

Over 1.4 million illegal immigrants are receiving taxpayer-funded benefits. Illegal immigrants with serious criminal records and links to terrorism have been receiving Medicaid. The One Big Beautiful Bill puts a stop to that and restores common sense. My latest op-ed ⬇️

The One Big, Beautiful Bill restores accountability to federal programs like Medicaid—ensuring that only legal, eligible Americans who truly need help receive it. We’re cracking down on the 1.4 million illegal immigrants receiving benefits and eliminating wasteful, duplicate payments.

The One Big Beautiful Bill reinstates work requirements for the 4.8 million able-bodied adults on Medicaid who choose not to work—and removes the 1.4 million illegal immigrants currently receiving benefits. It’s time to restore accountability and make sure federal aid goes to those who truly need it.

MYTH: The One Big Beautiful Bill will close rural hospitals.
 FACT: The bill invests $50 billion to strengthen rural health care—sending at least $100 million a year to every state to keep hospitals open, support providers, and improve care in small towns.

This bill protects rural health—not threatens it.

Every Medicaid dollar wasted on fraud is a dollar taken from someone who really needs care.

The One Big Beautiful Bill keeps Medicaid strong for those who deserve it. https://t.co/V8QfWHCEfi

The One Big Beautiful Bill:

✅Lowers taxes
✅Secures the border
✅Strengthens Medicaid for those who truly need it
✅Enforces real spending discipline

It’s what conservatives have promised for years. It’s what America needs. https://t.co/S1OalwqC3F

Only 7% of Medicaid hospital spending reaches rural communities. That’s unacceptable.

The One Big Beautiful Bill fixes it—with a $50 billion investment that guarantees at least $100 million a year for every state to support rural hospitals, providers, and patients.

This isn’t about more bureaucracy—it’s about real reinvestment where it’s needed most.
The One Big Beautiful Bill delivers the largest mandatory spending cut in decades—while protecting critical programs like Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid.
